prompt:
Look at the table in the image. It shows a ledger-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, strong horizontal rules, and minimal vertical separators. Determine which selected row wins under the requested target-column extremum after applying the filter condition. Filter the rows to those with values in Cost less than 19. Which row label has the largest Age value?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence field: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered supporting cell pairs [filter cell, target cell] for each selected row in top-to-bottom row order.
Answer field: set "answer" to the exact row-name string from the filtered rows.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[260,236,372,292],[374,236,486,292]],"answer":"Ava"}
